props.description:
This table lists the product attributes 
Links out to: Inventory, customer product, product cost, co products, lean board, work order and product strategy

This table lists work orders and it's attributes 
Links out to transfer order line, work order process, work order process distribution and, work order process BOM

props.label: Select
props.description: The primary unique ID of the record.  Every model should have an id field.

props.label: Created At
props.description: The date and time the record was created.

props.label: Raw Data
props.description: JSON of event data for scheduling run

This table lists work orders and it's attributes 
Links out to transfer order line, work order process, work order process distribution and, work order process BOM

props.label: Work Order
props.description: Label field, and the number of the Work Order.

props.label: Scheduled Start At
props.description: The date this work order is scheduled to start production

props.label: Scheduled Finish At
props.description: The date this work order is scheduled to finish production
Data is copied here from the Approved Workcenter Record for the process, if the "useGlobalRates" is true on the process - then the values are copied from the workcenter itself.

props.label: Scheduled Start At
props.description: What is the scheduled start date?

props.label: Scheduled Finish At
props.description: What is the scheduled finish date?

props.label: Estimated Time
props.description: Duration of time calculated for this distribution
